title: Python developer with Gen AI/Agent (Python/GCP)
description: Description & RequirementsWho we are looking forWe are seeking for Python Developer with experience in building AI systems. This role requires deep expertise in Python, experience or exposure to leading agent orchestration frameworks (ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, etc.), and extensive experience leveraging Google Cloud Platform’s Vertex AI suite. You will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing multi-step reasoning agents capable of advanced tool use, function calling, and managing diverse GenAI tasks across text and code generation domains. If you thrive on developing intelligent, goal-oriented AI applications, this is the role for you.Who We Are Looking ForYou are a pragmatic, solutions-focused developer with a robust background in software architecture and advanced AI concepts. You possess:Essential Python Proficiency: Exceptional expertise in Python is mandatory for ML development, API integration, and leveraging SDKs (Vertex AI SDK, OpenAI SDK). Agent Development Exposure: Experience in building and orchestrating complex AI workflows using state-of-the-art frameworks, specifically: LangChain, LangGraph, and ADK (Agent Development Kit). GenAI Task Experience: Practical experience developing solutions for core Generative AI tasks, including sophisticated function calling, code generation, classification, summarization, and prompt engineering for text generation. Grounding Techniques Knowledge: Understanding of grounding models using techniques like RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) to provide external, factual context for agents. GCP AI Ecosystem Familiarity: Strong working knowledge of key GCP GenAI and MLOps tools, including: Agent Tools: Direct experience utilizing Vertex AI Agent Builder for developing conversational and goal-oriented agents.Development Environments: A2A, Managed Compute Platform (MCP), Vertex AI Workbench/Notebooks for development.MLOps & Deployment: Vertex AI Pipelines for workflow orchestration.Model Management: Vertex AI Training for custom training, fine-tuning, and hyperparameter tuning.English proficiencyEU work permitNice-to-Have SkillsWhile not strictly required, candidates possessing the following skills will have a distinct advantage:Graph Databases: Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and their integration into LangGraph or RAG systems to manage complex relationships and contextual memory.Low-Latency Deployment: Experience optimizing GenAI applications for low-latency, high-throughput environments (e.g., using quantization or compiling models).Security & Compliance: Familiarity with data security principles related to PII/PHI handling within GenAI pipelines and implementing filtering mechanisms (e.g., DLP).Advanced MLOps: Deep experience with running production workloads on GKE or leveraging advanced features of Cloud Run for model serving.Your future roleAs a Generative AI Agent Developer, your primary responsibilities will include:Agent Orchestration: Design, develop, and deploy complex, multi-step AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and ADK, ensuring efficient state management and execution paths. Tool and Function Calling: Implement robust mechanisms for agents to utilize external APIs, custom Python functions, and specialized tools (Tool Use) to achieve complex goals and interact with enterprise systems. GCP Service Integration: Leverage the full suite of Vertex AI services (Agent Builder, Pipelines, Workbench) to manage the entire agent lifecycle, from testing to scalable production deployment. Model Integration and Customization: Integrate and manage various foundational models (GCP, open source) and utilize Vertex AI Training for model customization where required. Infrastructure & Networking: Utilize general GCP infrastructure knowledge, including Compute (Agent Engine, GKE, Cloud Run) for deployment, and adhere to networking standards (VPC, Load Balancing, Cloud DNS). Performance and Reliability: Implement rigorous testing and logging to monitor agent behavior, optimize token usage, ensure reasoning accuracy, and minimize potential hallucinations. Documentation & Best Practices: Document agent architectures, development processes, and promote reusable design patterns across the engineering team. Show more Show less

title: AI Research Scientist – Scientific Evaluation (ML/AI)
description: Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection. We’re looking for experienced ML/AI researchers with a strong publication track record at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) to support an advanced AI research evaluation project. You'll critically assess scientific papers and research outputs generated by autonomous AI research agents, evaluating their technical correctness, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality against the standards of leading ML/AI conferences. This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours. Tasks What you'll be doing What you'll be doing Critically evaluate AI-generated ML/AI research papers , assessing their scientific contributions, technical correctness, methodology, experimental design, and conclusions Assess scientific novelty and significance , determining whether proposed approaches represent meaningful advancements over existing state-of-the-art research Evaluate experimental rigor and validity , including baseline comparisons, benchmark selection, evaluation metrics, statistical evidence, and ablation studies Identify methodological flaws, unsupported claims, inconsistencies, or misleading results that undermine the scientific validity of proposed contributions Assess reproducibility and technical soundness , including whether reported findings are sufficiently supported by experimental evidence and, where available, accompanying code and implementation details Review and verify relevant academic literature , identifying overlooked prior work, inaccurate citations, and unsupported novelty claims Evaluate whether AI-generated research meets the scientific standards of top-tier ML/AI conferences , such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR Provide structured, evidence-based assessments of research quality, including strengths, weaknesses, critical technical concerns, and overall scientific merit Apply detailed evaluation rubrics consistently , providing clear, well-reasoned justifications for your assessments The project focuses on evaluating advanced AI-generated scientific research, with an emphasis on technical validity, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality. Your role is to provide expert human judgment on whether the resulting research is scientifically valid, genuinely novel, and of a quality comparable to work accepted at leading ML/AI conferences. Requirements You're a strong candidate if you: Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated research expertise Have published at least 3 peer-reviewed research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR (hard requirement) , ideally including first-author or significant research contributions Have substantial hands-on ML/AI research experience , including developing novel methods, designing experiments, analyzing results, and publishing original scientific work Have a strong understanding of scientific methodology and experimental rigor , including appropriate baselines, statistical validity, benchmark design, ablation studies, and reproducibility Can independently assess the novelty, significance, and technical soundness of advanced ML/AI research , identifying both meaningful scientific contributions and fundamental methodological weaknesses Have experience reviewing research papers for top-tier ML/AI conferences or journals , ideally NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR — strongly preferred Are highly familiar with state-of-the-art ML/AI research and can critically assess new methods against existing literature and established benchmarks Are comfortable verifying scientific claims , including reviewing technical arguments, experimental evidence, citations, and, where relevant, code implementations Have strong analytical and scientific writing skills and can articulate nuanced technical judgments through concise, evidence-based feedback Can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines and scoring rubrics while exercising independent expert judgment Have exceptional attention to detail , particularly when identifying subtle methodological flaws, unsupported conclusions, or discrepancies between claims and evidence Benefits Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere Part-time contractor role with flexible hours Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge autonomous AI systems capable of conducting end-to-end scientific research Apply your research expertise to help assess and advance the scientific capabilities of frontier AI agents Send us your CV along with a brief note about your research background, areas of expertise, and publication record. Please include links to at least 3 peer-reviewed publications at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR , as well as any relevant academic peer-review experience. If applicable, we'd also love to know which ML/AI research areas you're most familiar with and whether you've served as a reviewer, area chair, or in a similar capacity at major research conferences. We look forward to hearing from you! Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
